description: We are Volodymyr Chyzhevskyi and Andrii Khomych, a Ukrainian team from Zhytomyr Polytechnic passionate about technology, engineering, and innovation. We won 1st place at HackTheFICT and RE: ACCESS ZHYTOMYR, and 2nd place at STEM Hackathon. Our individual achievements include national and international awards in programming, software development, research, and engineering. We combine complementary skills, creativity, and a strong drive to build impactful solutions.
